hero.headline: Dodonai vs Filevine: Purpose-Built Legal AI, Alongside Your Case Management
hero.subheadline: Filevine is where you run your cases — matters, documents, deadlines, workflows. It has added AI features along the way. But the deepest document work — page-line deposition summaries and medical-record chronologies from thousands of pages — needs AI built for exactly that. Here's where Dodonai fits, and how it works alongside Filevine.

sections.heading: What Filevine Does — and Where Purpose-Built AI Goes Deeper
paragraphs: Filevine is a strong case-management platform, especially for litigation, personal injury, and mass-tort firms: case and document management, workflow automation, deadline tracking, and client communication in one system. It has layered in AI features to extract data into case fields and assist inside that workflow.

Where a purpose-built tool earns its place is the document-heavy work itself: converting a 6,000-page medical record into a clean, cited chronology, or a full deposition into a page-line summary you can rely on in prep. That's a different problem from running the case — and it's exactly what Dodonai is designed for.
So this isn't 'rip out Filevine.' It's: what handles the deepest document processing, and any custom AI your firm needs, alongside the case system you already run on?

sections.heading: Filevine + Dodonai, Together
paragraphs: For most litigation and PI firms, the best setup is Filevine running the cases and Dodonai handling the AI-heavy document work and any custom automation. You keep the case system your team already knows, and you add purpose-built AI for the work that eats the most associate and paralegal hours — record review, chronologies, deposition prep.

If you're weighing whether Filevine's built-in AI covers your medical-record and deposition work, run a real file through both and compare the output. Purpose-built shows up fast on the documents that matter.

faq.question: Does Dodonai replace Filevine?
faq.answer: No. Filevine is your case-management system — matters, documents, deadlines, workflows. Dodonai is purpose-built AI for the document-heavy work (medical-record chronologies, deposition summaries) and custom AI agents. Most firms run both: Filevine for the cases, Dodonai for the AI document layer around it.

faq.question: Isn't Filevine already adding AI? Why add another tool?
faq.answer: Filevine has added useful AI inside its case workflow, like extracting data into fields. Dodonai is built specifically for the deepest document processing — full chronologies and page-line summaries from thousands of pages, in multiple formats. The two solve different parts of the job; many firms use both.

faq.question: Can Dodonai work alongside Filevine?
faq.answer: Yes. Dodonai is designed to run around the tools you already use, not replace them. You keep Filevine as your case system and use Dodonai for the AI document work and any custom workflows.

faq.question: Is my client data secure with Dodonai?
faq.answer: Privileged files need SOC 2, HIPAA, and encryption at minimum. Dodonai is SOC 2 certified, HIPAA compliant, and AES-256 encrypted, with BAAs on every account. Your files are never used to train AI, and you control when they're deleted.

faq.question: What does 'you own the code' mean?
faq.answer: For custom AI agents our {{link:/ai-managed-services/|managed-services team}} builds for your firm, the resulting workflows are yours — you're not locked into leasing access forever. It's a different model from standard SaaS.
